title: BigP3BCI Study S1 — 9x8 face/house paradigm (10 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains 32-channel EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants in Study S1 of the BigP3BCI collection. Participants used a P300-based speller with a 9x8 character grid and a face/house stimulus paradigm. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags, and the data were recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier at 256 Hz. The data were converted into a BIDS derivative through MOABB from the original PhysioNet deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec g.USBamp from 32 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz. The line frequency was 60 Hz. Participants completed a P300 speller task with a calibration phase followed by online testing with feedback. Events were coded as Target or NonTarget, with a trial interval of 0 to 1.0 s.
